statement:
For 0 1^q -> 1^(q+1) 0^k the rightmost strategy from 0 1^(q(q+1)) reaches a self-embedding after 16, 32, 64 steps
(k = 2) and 260, 1556, 9332 steps (k = 6) for q = 4, 5, 6.
title: Loop lengths in the base family grow like k^q
